item.title: Banana Ball World Tour kicks off in Tallahassee with electric opener at Dick Howser Stadium
item.description: The Banana Ball League opened their 2026 World Tour at Dick Howser Stadium Thursday, with the Loco Beach Coconuts defeating the Firefighters. The Party Animals take on the Clowns Friday at 7 p.m.

item.title: Woodville second graders get creative with weather
item.description: These young meteorologists proved their creativity and weather knowledge when given one task: draw your favorite type of weather!

item.title: TEACHER SALARY INCREASES: LCTA look to negotiate again with LCS ahead of impasse hearing
item.description: The Leon Classroom Teachers Association voted against a one time,1% bonus offer from the District. LCTA says they hope to negotiate a new deal before an impasse hearing is scheduled.
